name: RelativeTime
description: `RelativeTime` renders a semantic `time` element with a human-readable relative value and a stable machine-readable date.

props.name: date
props.description: Instant being described.

props.name: datetime
props.description: Instant being described, as an ISO 8601 string. An alternative to `date`.

props.name: day
props.description: How the day of the month is rendered in an absolute date.

props.name: format
props.description: Which formatting scheme to use, such as a relative phrase, an elapsed duration, or a plain date.

props.name: formatStyle
props.description: How verbose the formatted output is.

props.name: hour
props.description: How the hour is rendered in an absolute date.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Hour cycle used for absolute times and titles. Overrides the nearest `hour-cycle` attribute.

props.name: minute
props.description: How the minutes are rendered in an absolute date.

props.name: month
props.description: How the month is rendered in an absolute date.

props.name: noTitle
props.description: Stops the full date being set as the element's `title`.

props.name: onRelativeTimeUpdated
props.description: Called whenever the rendered text changes as time passes.

props.name: precision
props.description: Smallest unit the output distinguishes, which also sets how often it refreshes.

props.name: prefersAbsoluteTime
props.description:
Shows the user's preferred absolute date and time instead of relative or micro output. Durations and elapsed timers
are unaffected. Defaults to reading `data-prefers-absolute-time="true"` on the document's `html` or `body` element,
and follows live changes to that attribute.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text placed before an absolute date, such as `on`.

props.name: second
props.description: How the seconds are rendered in an absolute date.

props.name: tense
props.description: Forces past or future phrasing rather than deriving it from the date.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Duration past which the output switches from a relative phrase to an absolute date.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: IANA time zone the date is presented in. Overrides the nearest `time-zone` attribute.

props.name: timeZoneName
props.description: How the time zone is named in the output, if at all.

props.name: weekday
props.description: How the weekday is rendered in an absolute date, if at all.

props.name: year
props.description: How the year is rendered in an absolute date.
